{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "concerned about 500 LOC complexity vs Python, lack of win64 cross-test support with CTest, and CI duplication"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3623201465",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Whether the argument filtering modification is an unrelated change",
      "quote": "Unrelated change?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Author explained why the handling was needed for direct mode and noted a potential separate bug",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3641442985"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3641442985",
      "status_by_quote": "Not quite, although it was incorrect (thanks!)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3623206731",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Call the test runner from the build directory instead of adding a new command-line option",
      "quote": "Why not follow the docs and call the test_runner from the build dir, which avoids having to pass the new option?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "Addressed in push by invoking the generated test_runner.py link/copy from the build directory",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3641462805"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3641462805",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed in latest push by invoking the generated build/test/functional/test_runner.py link/copy."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3623224266",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Drop the change or provide a rationale for resolving the source-tree path and setting PYTHON_GIL",
      "quote": "Could drop this, or add least add a short rationale for stuff like this?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "Author added documentation comment and dropped redundant PYTHON_GIL=1",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3641495121"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3641495121",
      "status_by_quote": "added a short comment documenting the source-tree resolution"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3685751131",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Exposing CTest execution in CI creates redundant workflows and risks silently ignoring TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA",
      "quote": "not sure about exposing this in CI. This will silently ignore `TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA`, and having two ways to achieve the same seems confusing anyway.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "Author proposed failing if TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA is non-empty, but maflcko pushed back questioning porting difficulty",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3711983733"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3713474956",
      "status_by_quote": "Why would porting be hard?"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3713474956",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Adds 500 lines of complex CMake logic when an alternative in Python would be far simpler",
      "quote": "This pull is adding 500 LOC of logic complexity, so my preference would be to at least keep the overhead low. Recall the alternative to this would be to write it in a few trivial lines of Python",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3713515684",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "CTest cannot run functional tests for win64 cross builds whereas a Python runner can",
      "quote": "Also, recall that Python would work when testing win64-cross builds, but CTest does not.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3794320300",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Rebase on top of PR 35846 for better error message handling",
      "quote": "You may want to rebase this on top of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35846, for better error (message) handling",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "author to respond to approach objections and update the PR as indicated",
      "id": "rc:4197612345"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added earlier missing review comments from maflcko (rc:3623201465, rc:3623224266, rc:3794320300). Updated rc:3685751131 to contested after maflcko pushed back in rc:3713474956."
}
